new mexico.ship_name: New Mexico State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP)
new mexico.state_note: New Mexico Legal Aid runs a Senior Law Program that gives free legal help to seniors statewide regardless of income.
new mexico.tax_note: New Mexico exempts Social Security benefits from state tax if your adjusted gross income is under $100,000 filing single or $150,000 married filing jointly ($75,000 married filing separately); above those limits, the federally taxable part of your benefits is taxed.

new york.ship_name: HIICAP — Health Insurance Information, Counseling, and Assistance Program
new york.state_note: The Legal Aid Society listed here serves New York City; elsewhere in the state, LawHelpNY lists the local free legal aid program for each county.
new york.tax_note: New York does not tax Social Security benefits at all — any amount taxed on your federal return is subtracted back out on your state return.

north carolina.state_note: SHIIP has trained volunteer counselors in all 100 North Carolina counties.
north carolina.tax_note: North Carolina does not tax Social Security benefits — any amount taxed on your federal return is subtracted on your state return.

north dakota.ship_name: North Dakota State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP)
north dakota.state_note: North Dakota's SHIP program is also known locally as SHIC, the State Health Insurance Counseling program.
north dakota.tax_note: North Dakota does not tax Social Security benefits — the federally taxable part is excluded on your state return, with no income limit since tax year 2021.

ohio.ship_name: Ohio Senior Health Insurance Information Program (OSHIIP)
ohio.state_note: Ohio has no single statewide legal-aid law firm; Ohio Legal Help is the statewide gateway that connects residents to their regional legal aid program.
ohio.tax_note: Ohio does not tax Social Security benefits — you subtract the federally taxable amount on the Ohio Schedule of Adjustments so it never enters your Ohio taxable income.

oklahoma.state_note: Oklahoma's SHIP program is also called MAP, the Medicare Assistance Program.
oklahoma.tax_note: Oklahoma does not tax Social Security benefits — the full amount included in your federal income is subtracted on your Oklahoma return.

oregon.state_note: Oregon has no sales tax, but it taxes most other retirement income, such as pensions and IRA withdrawals, at rates up to 9.9%.
oregon.tax_note: Oregon does not tax Social Security or Railroad Retirement benefits — any amount taxed federally is subtracted on your Oregon return.

pennsylvania.ship_name: PA MEDI — Pennsylvania Medicare Education and Decision Insight (formerly APPRISE)
pennsylvania.state_note: The Pennsylvania Legal Aid Network itself does not take cases — it coordinates eight regional legal aid programs covering all 67 counties, and PALawHelp.org points you to the one for your county.
pennsylvania.tax_note: Pennsylvania does not tax Social Security benefits — they are not one of the eight classes of income Pennsylvania taxes.

rhode island.state_note: Rhode Island's exemption is all-or-nothing: if your federal adjusted gross income is even $1 over the limit, you lose the entire exemption.
rhode island.tax_note: Rhode Island taxes Social Security benefits unless you have reached full retirement age and your federal adjusted gross income is under $107,000 filing single or $133,750 married filing jointly (2025 tax year), in which case your benefits are fully exempt.

south carolina.ship_name: South Carolina State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SC SHIP), also known as I-CARE
south carolina.state_note: South Carolina's SHIP program is also called I-CARE, short for Insurance Counseling Assistance and Referrals for Elders.
south carolina.tax_note: South Carolina does not tax Social Security benefits — the federally taxed amount is subtracted on your state return.
